scope:
Fresh GNU/Intel operator bytes, then hash-bound complete selectable products.

Every component compares actual production/candidate raw bytes. The transcript
is a factorized composition proof; full-shape startup separately checks their
joint allocation and dispatch. Device model exactness remains a screen gate.
 Draft split32 is exact to its own fixed reference, not production-draft arithmetic. Production draft is unchanged source identity. Full-model unchanged-target oracle equality remains a separate device gate.
cross_compiler: Exact per-compiler production oracle. Inherited production NaN payload differences across compilers are not candidate tolerances.
